description:
Ministry of  Parliamentary Reforms & Mass Media - National Film Corporation of Sri Lanka (The Cinema Projector Specifications) Orders No.1 of 2017 that shall be effective from 01.01.2017. 
National Film Corporation of Sri Lanka (Miscellaneous Rates) Orders No.2 of 2017 that shall be effective from 01.03.2017.
reasoning: This gazette contains orders made by the Minister under the National Film Corporation of Sri Lanka Act, establishing technical specifications and regulatory requirements for cinema operations. It creates new regulatory frameworks for digital projector standards, licensing requirements, and fee structures for film screenings. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
